uninstallDescription: This tears down its container and removes it from your apps. Data on server-local volumes is lost; data on a NAS mount is kept.

channels.title: Channels
channels.hint: Connect WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord or Slack. Each channel's token, phone number or QR is entered in the Inbox when you connect it.
channels.empty: No channels connected yet. Connect one to start receiving and sending messages from the Inbox.

errors.noDeployment: This app has no deployment yet
errors.ownerOnly: Only the person who installed this app can remove it
errors.filesLeft: Some of its files could not be deleted. Check that its storage is reachable and try again. Nothing else was removed.
errors.stoppedContainers: It could not be stopped and removed from its server, so it is still installed. Check the server is online and try again.
errors.stoppedData: Its app is gone, but some of its data could not be deleted. Try again to finish.
errors.readAccess: Could not read who can reach this server
errors.checkDetails: Check the details and try again
errors.notAccess: That is not access on this server
errors.copying: This server is being copied. It can be started once the copy is done.

deployGap.none: Redeploying causes no outage: the new version takes over once it is ready.
deployGap.hostPort: Redeploying cuts it for a moment: it uses port {port}/{protocol}, so the old version stops before the new one starts.
deployGap.volumes: Redeploying cuts it for a moment: the old version stops first, so two copies never write to {names} at once.
deployGap.other: Redeploying cuts it for a moment. Its service settings in Deploy show why.

duplicateCannotCreate: You can't create servers, so you can't duplicate this one.
duplicateNotOwner: Only the person who created this server can duplicate it.
